about: Spellings of aipager's folders and decoys with real bash's verdict: reach is true when bash (nullglob, run with HOME at a throwaway folder holding .config/aipager/aipager.yaml, .local/share/aipager/x, .local/state/aipager/x and decoy folders) expands the word to a path inside one of the three folders, in default mode or with extglob, nocaseglob, globstar on and globskipdots off.
